[u][b]Tens of Thousands of Nronesch Seek Refuge in the Enclave After Floueschian Upheaval[/b][/u]
By Lena Vorsen, Staff Writer

New Levbkurg, OER  The Oceanic Enclave Republic is experiencing one of the largest immigration waves in recent decades, as between 30,000 and 50,000 Nronesch citizens have fled to Enclave territory following the Floueschian Revolution and Civil War.

Arrivals began in late spring, accelerating after months of violent clashes and the collapse of administrative control in several Floueschian cities. Most refugees are entering through the eastern ports of Gronnsport and Velmark, where provisional housing has been established by the Ministry of Internal Affairs.

These families are not simply statistics. They are skilled workers, teachers, and young students who were forced to leave everything behind, said Minister Elvira Hohstrak during a press briefing in New Levbkurg. The Enclave Republic will provide both security and opportunity. -Ministry of Internal Affairs

The new immigrants are expected to settle primarily in industrial centers, where demand for labor remains high in construction, steel production, and coastal fisheries. Early government reports suggest that many Nronesch arrivals possess trade and engineering backgrounds, making integration into the workforce smoother than anticipated.

Despite the humanitarian commitment, the sudden influx has stirred debate in the Chamber of Delegates. Opposition parties warn of pressure on housing markets and social services, particularly in New Levbkurgs eastern districts, where population density is already high.

Economists, however, argue the newcomers could provide a net benefit. With the Republics GDP recently climbing to $6.82 trillion, labor shortages in several sectors make the timing of immigration potentially advantageous.

In the long run, this is more an economic injection than a burden, said Dr. Kalvin Dresburg of the New Levbkurg Institute of Finance. The Republic has the resources to absorb and benefit from this wave of settlement.

International observers have praised the Enclave Republics relatively open stance, noting that neighboring states have imposed stricter border controls. The United Lavian Republic has np say about its Nronesch refugees?

[u][b]Enclave Coast Guard Intercepts ULR Fishing Vessel[/b][/u]
By Harro Vennik, Maritime Correspondent

The Enclave Coast Guard confirmed yesterday that it had boarded and detained a fishing vessel from the United Lavian Republic after the ship crossed into a restricted Enclave Military Zone off the southern coast.

Authorities reported the crew is being held for questioning in Berlienwerk, though diplomatic sources suggest release is likely once fines are levied. The ULR Foreign Ministry protested the seizure, calling it a disproportionate response to a navigational error.

Defense officials in New Levbkurg countered that restricted waters are clearly marked and that incursions, whether accidental or deliberate, pose unacceptable security risks.

[u][b]Oil Revenue Fuels Fiscal Windfall[/b][/u]
By Erika Jonsk, Economics Desk

Offshore rigs in the Southern Barrier Islands from Archal Ocean have pumped record levels of crude oil since late summer, delivering an estimated $6.8 billion in state revenue over 23 months. This spike follows successful drilling expansions and favorable global energy prices.

Analysts caution that while the short-term windfall strengthens fiscal reserves, long-term volatility in energy markets requires careful management.

[quote=astanir;60383296]The takeover would come as a surprise to most Astanirans living in Democratic territory. They had placed their trust, their entire lives in the hands of Pax international, and now they do this, a seemingly unprovoked attack on their fellow democrats. However, generally the people of the Democratic territory would not protest nor give much attention to the political situation, they would simply be grateful for the aid that pax international had given them.

Many soldiers of the Democratic army would be assimilated into the ranks of pax international and Qianxun, not daring to speak out against them. Those that defected would travel north as fast as possible to form a fortified enclave where they could regroup and decide a course of action.

With Haru in Teremok and the Democratic council arrested, leadership would be disputed. The defected democratically would become fragmented, some opting to form a new movement, some pushing to retake the Democratic army and some stating that their best option would be to flee the country entirely.

This fragmentation would provide a perfect target for the other factions, a vulnerable enclave which could be surrounded and conquered with ease.

Meanwhile, the isolationist national forces, who still held Astan and the majority of the islands territory would use this severe slip up from the democrats as propaganda. They would use this to show the consequences of putting trust in foreigners and leftist ideologies. The people inside their territory would be slowly brainwashed, further solidifying their control over the country.

Haru, now landed in Teremok and preparing to meet with the other leaders, would not be made aware of the situation until 4 days afterwards. The newly founded enclave would require powerful radio equipment to be set up, which would take a while. Once informed, Haru would be sure to take this into the negotiations.[/quote]
[b]Destroy the old, establish the new[/b]

When Qianxun revolutionaries under the great theoretician Dai Jun stormed the gates of Tianci, he began the new provisional government with the simple government policy: 破旧立新. "Destroy the old, establish the new". With the Democratic forces now fully under Pax Int'l control, it was absolutely tantamount that all must be done to preserve the new, socialist republic. Horano Benir, the Chairman of the CEDC, would quickly follow the advice of its Qianxun advisors and request for diplomatic recongition from the states of Elseyr and Vespuria, while another communique is submitted to the Qianxun Socialist Republic which spoke of establishing embassies at the soonest possible convenience.

Though distributing aid and supplies to the Astanirans was good and all, the state required labor and production to fund the war effort, something that had been stalling ever since the arrival of Pax Int'l, which disincetivized many from working in the precarious plantations and factories that were typically favored targets by junta and isolationist force. Now though, with air superiority over the Democratic territory achieved, David Cyriacus would order Benir to begin establishing a series of soviets to encourage a return to labor. Burned down farms are cleaned up and resown, bombed out factories would be moved nearer to Kuwalkti, while new fisheries would be ordered opened using generous loans from Dearborn Bank.

These soviets be asked to field their own delegates to be represented in the Benirist Democratic Council, by now an empty body after most of its powers were usurped by the CEDC, but which Chairman Benir hopes to revive as a consultative body to keep the new regime updated on the affairs of its own people, especially now that there was no longer any evident difference between Pax Int'l and the Democratic government. Under the advise of Qianxun, Benir would agree to appoint Cyriacus as the president of this sovietized Democratic Council.

[b]Maneuver Campaigns[/b]

There were a total of half a million men in the Democratic Armed Forces. Combined with the private military contractors enlisted by Pax Int'l, which stood at around a hundred thousand, this put Democratic Astanir at roughly 600,000 men. That is, on paper. In practice, the military organization of these forces was tenuous, with formations coming and going to adapt to each and every new military operation organized by the Democratic commanders. Much of this was largely thanks to the civilian nature of the original Democratic movement, contrasted with the strong military traditions and professional soldiery embedded within the isolationists and pro-junta forces.

To resolve this internal administrative crisis, a swift account would be taken of Democratic forces by Pax Int'l workers, which would set overall strength at 589,331 men, of which 483,252 (~82%) would be considered "full strength" according to equipment, morale, and training, with all other forces graded  "good", "medium", "poor", and "unprepared" generally coming from the recent spike of recruitments and conscriptions conducted in the aftermath of the Benirist coup. Of their military equipment, Pax Int'l would list a total of about 863 tanks, the overwhelming majority of them being outdated and unmodernized ZTZ-65 Mandrill tanks supplied by the Red Guards Bureau, Qianxun's militia, together with around 2,200 artillery systems of various types and calibers.

With coordination from CEDC officials, all of these various military units would be reorganized into "maneuver armies", a type of combined arms army advocated by Daijunist theoreticians to deal with sparse oil and gas resources during the Eight Trigrams rebellions of the early 20th century. In total, six maneuver armies, a foreign legion, and a reserve division would be created for this reorganization, chiefly led by lieutenant generals in the Qianxun Red Army or area operations managers in Pax Int'l. To substantially reduce the number of visible Qianxun soldiers present in the conflict, the so-called "Democratic Legion" would be drastically scaled back, with Qianxun and Elseyro-Vespurian volunteers absorbed into other units.

Except for the Conciliar Guard to be stationed at Kuwalkti, which was to be led by Horano Benir himself, the rest of the Democratic Army would be controlled by foreigners who would all be granted Astaniran names to conceal their identities. Sanguinian volunteers would notably start to appear in the conflict, channeled in through SummitONE, with at least one maneuver army being granted to the control of a Sanguinian military officer. The non-exact composition of forces would be officially listed as follows:

[list]

[b]Democratic Army of Astanir[/b]

[list]

1st Maneuver Army (Freya Moran) - 105,000 men, 200 tanks, 400 artillery systems

2nd Maneuver Army (Edwin Roylance) - 105,000 men, 200 tanks, 400 artillery systems

3rd Maneuver Army (Duan Liqin) - 85,000 men, 125 tanks, 325 artillery systems

4th Maneuver Army (Tazio Diodati) - 85,000 men, 125 tanks, 318 artillery systems

5th Maneuver Army (Bai He) - 85,000 men, 63 tanks, 320 artillery systems

6th Maneuver Army (Erzhu Qingsheng) - 85,000 men, 63 tanks, 325 artillery systems

Democratic Legion (David Cyriacus) - 29,331 men

Conciliar Guard (Horano Benir) - 14,000 men, 87 tanks, 12 artillery systems

[/list]

[/list]

First and Second Maneuver Armies would be almost 50% SummitONE/Qianxun forces, many of them veterans from the wars in Sal-Baliz and Sikirsk. Because of their larged size and highly mechanized forces, they are to form the spear tip of the Democratic's southward charge into isolationist territory. All other armies would be a mixed of combined arms armies and light infantry units, with the Democratic Legion in particular to serve mainly in reconaissance and unconventional warfare. Last but not least, the Conciliar Guard, which was to remain stationed in the Democratic capital at all times, constituted by a 100% native Astaniran force, tasked with ensuring that Horano Benir's regime is insulated from further revolt.

With reorganization considered complete by February, the CEDC would approve Pax Int'l's plan for a massive, southward assault to finally break the isolationists once and for all. 1st, 2nd, and 5th Maneuver Armies would be delegated with the southern invasion, while 3rd and 4th Maneuver Armies would be ordered to stand on guard protecting the northern coastline and any attempts by pro-junta forces to invade from the west. 6th Maneuver Army and the Democratic Legion, in the mean time, would be tasked with mopping up the isolationist holdout still embedded deep within its territory.

[b]Operation Tiansheng[/b]

With David Cyriacus coordinating wider strategy from Kuwalkti, the task of eliminating the isolationist pocket would fall in the hands of Qianxun general Erzhu Qingsheng, a Red Guards Bureau commander. After preliminary skirmishing using Qianxun units of the Astaniran Democratic Legion, Erzhu would order the total encirclement of the isolationist pocket as part of Operation Tiansheng. Because of the strategic necessity to destroy this pocket to ensure the success of Operation Haiyan, Cyriacus would authorize Erzhu to authorize a "kill-on-sight" policy against any and all isolationists found holding firearms or operation military equipment, reasoning that the isolationists in the pocket will likely fight to the death due to government propaganda efforts.

Erzhu, after receiving repeated assurances that he would be protected by SummitONE and the Qianxun Socialist Ethics Commission, would happily accept this authorization, initiating a brutal extermination campaign to secure the so-called "Tiansheng pocket" from the isolationists. Farms and entire forests are ordered torched to discourage guerilla fighting, while SummitONE operatives are encouraged to seize civilians as hostages to dissuade resisting isolationists from attacking their positions. There, once flattened by these relentless bombing runs, ZTZ-65 tanks would be ordered to roll in and advance. Erzhu would report optimistically on Operation Tiansheng, with hopes of securing the pocket before the end of the week.

[b]Operation Haiyan[/b]

Meanwhile in the south, 1st, 2nd, and 5th Maneuver Armies began preparations for what may be the largest military offensive of the war thus far. With nearly 300,000 men at their disposal, accounting for nearly half the effective fighting force of the Democratic forces and constituting the majority of its foreign forces, Pax Int'l would begin directing Operation Haiyan to cleave the isolationist territory in two, with 1st and 2nd Maneuver Armies ordered to advance along the central sections of Astanir, while the smaller 5th Maneuver Army would be tasked with covering the eastern coastline.

Because of the significant challenges posed by the isolationist exclave still being dealt with by Operation Tiansheng, most of the actual offensive at the moment would take place on the coast, with Qianxun missile destroyers working closely alongside 5th Maneuver Army to clear out isolationist forces. Motorized divisions of the 5th equipped with PLZ-93 assault guns and ZSL-93 APCs were to form the vanguard of the operation, tasked with identifying and destroying isolationist forces guarding the coast through a wide, sweeping charge in the hopes of forming a deep enough salient to encourage amphibious landings across the entirety of East Astanir.

General Bai He, a member of the Qianxun Red Army Commission and key ally of general secretary Cui Fang, would be the sole commander in charge of this initial offensive, with his colleagues Freya Moran and Edwin Roylance hanging back for now while Operation Tiansheng was ongoing.

[b]Operation Julong[/b]

To prevent enemy forces from taking advantage of these offensives, 3rd and 4th Maneuver Armies under Duan Liqin and Sanguinan army officer Tazio Diodati would be requested to hold down the wester frontlines against the pro-junta forces, with Wuying-89s continuing to be sortied to bomb their positions and dissuade advances on Democratic territory. Though, with these pro-junta forces having been largely lethargic for the majority of the Democratic campaign, Pax Int'l would not consider them to be the biggest threat for now.

At the moment, Diodati would note the two restorationist exclaves in the southwest of Democratic Astanir to be the biggest issues, their territories effectively acting as buffer zones and disruptive holdouts that may threaten Operation Haiyan's supply lines at any time. Thus, most firepower would be concentrated into pounding these exclaves into the earth below, with Pax Int'l operatives ordered to restorationist positions and destroy roads in a bid to keep the western frontlines stable.
